unsupported_claims: My best guess is that the comparison showed similar embedding quality (no meaningful difference) while the full-batch Newton-style optimizer was considerably slower per run.
rationale: The answer correctly declines to confirm the false premise and admits the papers do not identify the Newton-style comparison, which is supported by the evidence showing ASGD is used for Eqn. (7). However, its 'best guess' about similar embedding quality and per-run slowdown is an invented specific not found in the evidence, so it is unsupported.
